decisions.reason: The same message already establishes the dashboard's investment-story purpose and required viability, bankability, returns, debt, and investor information; the presentation narrative adds no distinct candidate-state change.
The candidate already requires a simpler, understandable, and auditable model, while the source presentation narrative does not alter those usability attributes.
The narrative about financial viability, bankability, and investor attractiveness does not change the model's assumption sources, provisional-input policy, disclosure, or traceability requirements.

The source reinforces the general viability and bankability story but does not change the existing requirement to prove that availability-style payments are necessary and user fees alone are insufficient.
Requiring the model to work technically and support a persuasive investment story does not modify any calculation-integrity, review-coverage, correction, or credibility attribute.
The presentation narrative does not change the required Excel working format or the prohibition on substituting the error-prone PDF.
The source does not change the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
The source calls for clear communication of project returns but does not alter the candidate's equity-IRR calculation requirement or target range; dashboard communication is represented separately.
The broader investment narrative does not modify the specified CCA classes, depreciation treatment, tax-shield modeling, or treatment of equity-return effects.
The source does not change the provisional 55/45 financing structure, approximate interest rate, tranche structure, or exclusion of a mezzanine layer.
The presentation narrative neither changes the AUD and 2031 model basis nor resolves the existing currency ambiguity concerning the CAD-denominated opex input.
The source does not change the accepted CAD 48–64M annual opex range, full-network scope, provisional status, assumption-flagging rule, or exclusion of the Appendix figure.
